params.message:
Tell Attio what happens on gentells.com

An outbox adapter beside Clay's. Each event finds the person in Attio
by e-mail address (an upsert, never a second record), sets what is true
now and leaves a note on the timeline:

- newsletter.confirmed: Gentells newsletter ticked
- account.created: Gentells plan Explore, account since, user id, and
  the company by e-mail domain (not for mailbox providers)
- contact.received: name and company, the message as a note
- subscription.*: Gentells plan once the change takes effect; a note
  for each change except renewals

gentells:attio-setup makes the four fields and the plan options once;
gentells:attio-backfill queues the past outbox events for Attio.
Without ATTIO_API_KEY the adapter wants nothing.

Portal: Wat er op gentells.com gebeurt (nieuwsbrief, account, plan, contactbericht) komt voortaan in Attio, per persoon met een tijdlijn.
